briefdescription.para: Handles the interrupt when data is received.

detaileddescription.para: Handles either a single byte when FIFOs are not enabled, or multiple bytes with the FIFO.

briefdescription.para: Handles the interrupt when data has been sent.

detaileddescription.para: The transmit FIFO is empty (transmitter holding register).
This function sets the handler called when an event (interrupt) occurs in the driver. The handler allows application-specific processing.

parameterdescription.para: Upper layer callback reference passed back when the callback function is invoked.

simplesect.para: There is no assert on the CallBackRef since the driver does not know what it is (nor should it)

briefdescription.para: Handles interrupts for the UART Lite driver.

detaileddescription.para: It must be connected to an interrupt system such that it is called when an interrupt for any UART lite occurs. This function does not save or restore the processor context such that the caller must ensure this occurs.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the instance of the UART that the interrupt is for.

detaileddescription.para: After calling this function, data may still be received by the UART but no interrupt is generated since the hardware device has no way to disable the receiver.

An interrupt occurs when data is received or data has been transmitted. The device contains 16 byte receive and transmit FIFOs such that an interrupt is generated anytime there is data in the receive FIFO and when the transmit FIFO transitions from not empty to empty.

briefdescription.para: Interrupt-related functions for the UART Lite component (XUartLite).
